verdict.rationale: Lorikeet says you deploy the agent only on the topics it is trained for and leave the rest with your team. It also describes response guardrails that can block, rewrite or escalate, and code-enforced workflow-scoped tool access. Together these imply topic scoping with human handoff. However, the evidence never shows a direct control for marking specific topics like legal threats, cancellations or security as human-only. Missing for 10: an explicit human-only topic or routing configuration, documented deterministic enforcement that the agent never responds on excluded topics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
